<string name="settings_deadline_reminders_subtitle">On-device reminders before benefits deadlines you scan. Turn this off to silence them all — your saved deadlines aren\'t deleted and return when you turn it back on.</string>
<string name="settings_content_sources_empty">No configurable sources yet — enable a source under Plugins to set it up here.</string>
<string name="settings_reading_shake_extend_subtitle">Shake during the fade-out to add 15 more minutes.</string>
<string name="settings_reading_autoscroll_subtitle">Follow the narrated sentence down the page automatically.</string>
<string name="settings_reading_focus_subtitle">Dim the off-focus lines and centre the active line for distraction-free reading.</string>
<string name="settings_reading_overlay_subtitle">Tint the reading page only — sepia, cream, or high-contrast. Doesn\'t change the rest of the app.</string>
<string name="settings_reading_overlay_preview">The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.</string>
<string name="settings_reading_font_subtitle">Applies to the chapter text only, not the rest of the app.</string>
<string name="settings_reading_preview_text">The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Reading should feel comfortable.</string>
<string name="settings_highlight_mode_subtitle">How the reader marks the words being narrated.</string>

<string name="settings_bookshare_help">Bookshare requires a partner API key issued by Benetech. With a key stored, you can search and browse the accessible-book catalog. Downloading protected titles needs a separate partner agreement.</string>

<string name="settings_advanced_auto_items_subtitle">How many items each Auto category exposes (Library / Follows / Recent / New). 6 matches Google\'s head-unit guideline; large libraries may prefer 8 or 12.</string>
<string name="settings_about_handbook_subtitle">The Candela user guide — narrated, and it works offline.</string>
<string name="settings_about_replay_tour_subtitle">Show the first-launch welcome again — no restart needed.</string>

<string name="settings_licenses_gpl_body">Candela is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0. You\'re free to use, study, share, and modify it under those terms. It is built on the open-source libraries listed below.</string>
<string name="settings_ai_sessions_subtitle">Review and manage past chats and chapter recaps.</string>
<string name="settings_voice_hq_pitch_on">Smoother pitch-shifted audio. ~20%% extra CPU per chapter render.</string>
<string name="settings_voice_hq_pitch_off">Faster pitch shifting. Some grittiness at non-neutral pitch.</string>
<string name="settings_voice_autolang_on">Foreign passages switch to a matching voice. Kokoro voices only.</string>
<string name="settings_voice_autolang_off">Off — all text reads in your selected voice.</string>
<string name="settings_voice_pronunciation_subtitle">Teach the voice how to say specific names and words.</string>

<string name="settings_voice_rewind_subtitle">Past this point in a chapter, the prev-track button rewinds to the start. Within it, jumps to the previous chapter. Off (0s) always goes to the previous chapter.</string>
<string name="settings_voice_shake_extend_subtitle">Minutes the timer extends when you shake during the 10-second fade tail.</string>
<string name="settings_voice_bedtime_auto_title">Start timer in Bedtime or Do Not Disturb</string>
<string name="settings_voice_bedtime_auto_subtitle">When your phone enters Bedtime, Sleep, or Do Not Disturb mode, a sleep timer starts automatically.</string>
<string name="settings_voice_dnd_sleep_title">Turn on Do Not Disturb during a timer</string>

<string name="settings_voice_dnd_sleep_subtitle">The reverse: while a sleep timer is running, silence notifications with Do Not Disturb, then restore your previous setting when it ends. Needs Do Not Disturb access.</string>
<string name="settings_voice_sleep_default_subtitle">How long a new sleep timer runs when you start one without picking a time.</string>
<string name="settings_voice_shake_enable_subtitle">Shake your device during the timer\'s fade-out to keep listening.</string>
<string name="settings_downloads_mode_lazy_desc">Download each chapter when you start playing it. Uses the least storage.</string>
<string name="settings_downloads_mode_eager_desc">Download every chapter as soon as you add a book, so it\'s ready offline.</string>
<string name="settings_downloads_mode_subscribe_desc">Download the current chapters, then auto-fetch new ones as they\'re published.</string>
<string name="settings_downloads_wifi_subtitle">Defer downloads until you\'re on an unmetered network.</string>
<string name="settings_downloads_poll_subtitle">How often to check followed books for new chapters.</string>
<string name="settings_performance_catchup_on">Pause briefly when the voice falls behind, then resume cleanly.</string>
<string name="settings_performance_full_prerender_on">Cache every chapter of every library fiction in the background. Aggressive disk + CPU use; gapless playback everywhere.</string>
<string name="settings_performance_full_prerender_off">Cache the next few chapters only (1-3 on add, +2 on chapter end). Lighter on disk.</string>
<string name="settings_performance_cache_size_subtitle">How much disk to use for cached audiobook PCM. Larger = more chapters playable instantly; smaller = less disk used.</string>

<string name="settings_performance_clear_cache_confirm_body">Frees %1$s of disk. Chapters you replay will re-render the first time you play them. Library and reading positions are not affected.</string>
<string name="settings_performance_prerender_window_subtitle">How many chapters ahead the cache renders. Smaller = less disk + bandwidth; larger = more chapters ready for instant playback.</string>
<string name="settings_performance_network_patience_subtitle">Network timeout budget for source plugins. Aggressive fails fast on flaky links; Patient gives slow APIs more room.</string>
<string name="settings_performance_warmup_on">Wait for the voice to warm up before playback starts.</string>
<string name="settings_performance_warmup_off">Start playback immediately; accept silence at chapter start.</string>
<string name="settings_performance_determinism_on">Steady — identical text plays the same each time.</string>
<string name="settings_accessibility_high_contrast_subtitle">Use a higher-contrast variant of Library Nocturne. Auto-enables when TalkBack is active.</string>

<string name="settings_accessibility_reduced_motion_subtitle">Disable non-essential animations (chip slides, brass shimmer, page-transition curves). Auto-enables when the system \"Remove animations\" setting is on.</string>
<string name="settings_accessibility_touch_targets_subtitle">Increase tap-target minimums from 48dp to 64dp where feasible. Auto-enables when Switch Access is active.</string>
<string name="settings_accessibility_pauses_subtitle">Extra pause between sentences when TalkBack is active.</string>
<string name="settings_accessibility_font_scale_subtitle">Multiplier on top of Android\'s system font scale.</string>
<string name="settings_accessibility_direction_subtitle">Escape hatch for RTL testing and locale-mismatch overrides.</string>

<string name="settings_accessibility_about_subtitle">These settings improve Candela for users who rely on TalkBack, Switch Access, or other accessibility tools. Most adapt automatically when assistive services are detected.</string>
<string name="settings_accessibility_learn_more_subtitle">Open the accessibility documentation in your browser.</string>
<string name="settings_accessibility_talkback_active">TalkBack is active. The screen-reader-related settings on this page are taking effect right now.</string>

<string name="settings_accessibility_talkback_nudge_body">The screen-reader-related settings below activate when you turn on TalkBack in Android Settings → Accessibility. Some devices ship with TalkBack pre-installed; on others you\'ll need to install Android Accessibility Suite from the Play Store.</string>
<string name="settings_appearance_cover_style_subtitle">What to show when a fiction has no cover image.</string>
<string name="settings_appearance_cover_only_subtitle">Real cover when available, dim sigil outline otherwise</string>

<string name="settings_appearance_about_covers_subtitle">Real cover images are always used when available. This setting controls what we render when a fiction has no cover, the cover URL has expired, or the load fails.</string>
<string name="settings_appearance_animation_speed_subtitle">Master multiplier on every transition. Off makes animations instant — useful with assistive tech or on slower devices.</string>
<string name="settings_appearance_particle_subtitle">Brass-ember sparks + chapter-completion flare. None silences decorative particles; Lush doubles the count.</string>
<string name="settings_appearance_skeleton_subtitle">How loading placeholders look. Off = plain rectangle, Pulse = breathing rectangle, Sigil = rotating brass sigil.</string>
<string name="settings_appearance_brass_pulse_subtitle">How deep the brass breath cycles on loading dots, the player sigil, and skeleton tiles.</string>
<string name="settings_account_secrets_body">Encrypt API keys and tokens with a passphrase before syncing them to the cloud. The same passphrase is needed on every device.</string>
<string name="settings_account_cloud_sync_signin_subtitle">Sign in to sync library, follows, positions, and secrets across devices.</string>
<string name="settings_account_royal_road_signin_subtitle">Sign-in unlocks Premium chapters and your Follows list.</string>
<string name="settings_account_ao3_signed_in_subtitle">Your AO3 session unlocks Subscriptions and Marked for Later in Browse.</string>
<string name="settings_account_ao3_signin_subtitle">Sign in to AO3 to read your Subscriptions and Marked for Later.</string>
<string name="settings_section_reading_descriptor">How chapter text and the reader behave.</string>
<string name="settings_section_performance_descriptor">Trade memory and CPU for smoother playback.</string>
<string name="settings_section_library_descriptor">Where stories come from and how often we check for updates.</string>
<string name="settings_legacy_plugins_subtitle">Fiction sources, audio streams, and voice bundles.</string>

<string name="settings_google_news_full_text_subtitle">Narrate the full publisher article instead of just the headline digest. Off by default — uses Google\'s internal endpoint (may break on their changes) and is intended for personal feed-reader use.</string>
<string name="settings_inbox_royalroad_subtitle">New-chapter events from your Royal Road follows.</string>
<string name="settings_inbox_kvmr_subtitle">Live programs starting on KVMR Community Radio.</string>
<string name="settings_inbox_wikipedia_subtitle">Updates to followed Wikipedia articles. (No diff poller yet — see #383 follow-up.)</string>
<string name="settings_section_account_descriptor">Sign-in for fiction sources that need it.</string>
<string name="settings_section_palace_descriptor">Browse your local mempalace as fictions (LAN only).</string>
<string name="settings_section_cloud_voices_descriptor">Bring your own Azure key for HD Neural and Dragon HD voices.</string>
<string name="settings_developer_overlay_on">A compact pipeline-state card floats above the reader.</string>
<string name="settings_developer_reset_onboarding_subtitle">Show the first-launch welcome flow again. Restart the app to see it.</string>
<string name="library_add_by_url_subtitle">Paste a fiction URL — we\'ll auto-detect the source.</string>
<string name="library_add_by_url_supported">Supported: Royal Road · AO3 · GitHub · Gutenberg · arXiv · RSS · Wikipedia · direct EPUB</string>
<string name="library_add_by_url_chooser_title">Where do you want to add this from?</string>
<string name="library_add_by_url_chooser_subtitle">Several sources can handle this URL. Pick the one that fits best.</string>
<string name="settings_github_anon_subtitle">Sign in lifts the 60 req/hr anon cap to 5,000 req/hr and unlocks repository READMEs as fictions. read:user + public_repo only.</string>
<string name="settings_github_private_needs_resign">ON. Sign out and back in to upgrade to the `repo` scope (read/write to private + public repos).</string>
<string name="settings_github_private_downgrade">OFF. Current token still carries the `repo` scope; sign out and back in to drop down to `public_repo`.</string>
<string name="settings_github_private_on">Sign-in requests `repo` (full repo, read/write, includes private).</string>
<string name="settings_github_revoke_subtitle">Sign-out clears the local token; use this to revoke Candela\'s authorization on GitHub\'s side too.</string>
<string name="settings_github_expired_subtitle">Session expired — sign in again to recover.</string>
<string name="ocr_capture_intro">Point your camera at a printed page, or pick a photo, and Candela reads it aloud. Scan several pages to make one document.</string>
<string name="ocr_camera_rationale">To scan printed text, Candela needs camera access. Nothing leaves your device — text recognition runs entirely offline.</string>
<string name="ocr_camera_denied">Camera access is off. You can still scan by picking a photo from your gallery below, or turn the camera on in system Settings.</string>
<string name="ocr_capture_button_cd">Capture this page for text recognition</string>
<string name="library_scan_page_cd">Scan a printed page to read aloud</string>
<string name="stats_empty_body">Finish a chapter and your reading stats will appear here.</string>
<string name="stats_estimate_note">Time figures are estimates based on the length of the chapters you\'ve finished — Candela doesn\'t track exact playback time yet.</string>

<string name="impact_card_body">Candela is run by TechEMPOWER, a nonprofit. Grants that keep the app free need impact numbers across everyone — never you. You can choose to share an anonymous, rounded monthly summary to help. Nothing is ever sent automatically.</string>
<string name="impact_card_all_shared">Thanks — this month\'s summary has been shared.</string>
<string name="impact_preview_intro">This is exactly what will be shared — nothing more. You choose where it goes (email, a message, a form). Candela never sends it for you.</string>
<string name="impact_shared_line_totals">Coarse monthly totals, rounded — hours, chapters, and books</string>
<string name="impact_shared_line_sources">Which built-in sources you used — names only, never counts</string>
<string name="impact_shared_line_meta">The month and the app version (major.minor only)</string>
<string name="impact_never_line_identity">Your name, email, or any account</string>
<string name="impact_never_line_device">Your device, location, or IP address</string>
<string name="impact_never_line_content">Titles, links, or anything you actually read</string>
<string name="impact_never_line_traceback">Anything that could point back to you</string>
<string name="impact_preview_withdrawal">A report you share lives wherever you send it. Candela keeps no copy, and because it carries no identifier, TechEMPOWER can\'t trace one back to you.</string>
<string name="settings_about_impact_subtitle">How the optional anonymous summary works</string>

<string name="impact_about_intro">Candela is run by TechEMPOWER, a nonprofit. The grants that keep the app free — and radically private — need aggregate impact numbers: total hours listened, chapters and books finished, and the range of sources people use, summed across everyone who chooses to share. Never you specifically.</string>

<string name="impact_about_where">There\'s no switch to leave on and nothing is ever sent automatically. When you want to help, open your Listening Stats screen, preview the exact anonymous summary, and share it — that one tap is the whole feature.</string>
<string name="audiobook_creating_body">Narrating chapters offline. This keeps going in the background.</string>
<string name="create_audiobook_intro">Paste or type your text, pick a voice, and Candela narrates it into a chaptered audiobook you can keep and share — all offline, no account.</string>
<string name="create_audiobook_text_placeholder">Paste a chapter, an article, a story…</string>

<string name="decoder_unknown_body">We will not guess what your letter says. You can hear it read aloud, or call 211 for free help understanding it.</string>
